title: kramastotra — kram-p22-v22
question: This ground she holds — world-fear-splitting-dread-making; this wake-one-pointed-melted-taste-formed — ordained too. So holding, melting, wiping inauspicious stretches, as-pleased conduct resorted — may she sport in my heart.
